secondPassBrief.text:
SECOND PASS BRIEF (from engineering review, 2026-10-14). Direction approved; keep neutrals, glass, glow, Manrope, tick knob, EQ layout, band panel.

1 COLOUR FIXES
- Band 1 #5CC8FF = EQ accent (breaks 'bands never use accent'). Rotate ramp per plugin or pick a ramp that avoids every accent. Show EQ, Multiband, Sat.
- Band 2 #FFB547 = sem.warn = solo ring. Give solo its own treatment (white ring + S badge, others dimmed); amber = warnings only.
- Band 3 #FF6FA8 ~ Shape accent #FF6FB5. Band 4 #8EE07A = sem.ok.
- sem.gr #FF8A3D sits between Comp #FF9F43 and Sat #FF7A45: GR must read as GR in exactly those plugins.
- Limit accent #FF5E6C ~ sem.collision #FF4D6A.
- Every colliding pair must also differ in lightness. Show colour-blind theme beside default on the EQ.
- Tokenise mockup-only values: button #12161C/#222832, panel control #1E232B/#2E3540, knob disc #161A21, segment track #0C0F13, grid #151920/#1D232C, curve #DDF3FF, post-fill #3D6FD9.

2 CONTRAST
- Help strip hint #5C6573 on #0C0E12 = 3.3:1, needs 4.5:1. Disabled #4A5260 only for disabled controls. Check light theme too.

3 HIT TARGETS
- Segments are 26 px; blueprint asks >= 32 px at 100 % (future iPad). Add a 32 px variant or document 26 px desktop + touch variant.

4 MISSING EQ SCREENS (1280x760)
Empty state · Linear Phase (resolution + latency) · Collision/masking view with carve suggestion · Spectrum grab hover/drag · Spectral dynamic + Resonance bands · Multi-select + lasso · Right-click menus · Preset browser · Settings sheet · Help ? overlay · Compact 640x400 · Light theme full screen.

5 SHARED COMPONENTS
Modulation matrix · Comp transfer-curve editor (4-node) · Waveform/GR history · Spectrogram.

6 interaction.md
Gesture map (+ touch), state transitions with duration/easing tokens, band-panel placement rules, knob drag maths (px per range, fine factor, wheel steps), keyboard focus order, reduce-motion behaviour.

Full brief: github.com/ansabic/MiteFX docs/design/second-pass-brief.md

thirdPassBrief.text:
THIRD PASS BRIEF (engineering review of pass 2, 2026-10-14). Pass 2 approved: every screen, theme and shared component stays as drawn. This pass is system clean-up so tokens can be generated into code.

1 PLUGIN ACCENT TABLE
All 15 plugins x 3 themes (dark, light, colour-blind). No accent within dE ~15 of any band-ramp or semantic colour. Comp #6095FA, Limit #B9E855, Delay #DB76D3 are band 1, 2 and 5 colours; Comp (sidechain EQ) and Delay (per-tap EQ) draw bands, so they must move. Unrevised accents still collide: Verb~band 1, Gate~band 2/ok, Shape~band 3, Soothe~band 4, Multiband~band 7, Sat~gr.

2 BAND RAMP
Band 6 #D4DCE5 is 1.2:1 against the total curve #DDF3FF (2.3:1 in light): use a hue. Band 2 #B9E855 has the same lightness as ok #65E287: separate them.

3 COLOUR-BLIND THEME
#E6EAF0 is reused for band 3, ok, sidechain and text; warn is pure white. Split them, and give ok/warn a non-colour cue (icon or pattern).

4 SEMANTIC NAMES
Split clip into masking (hatch overlay) and danger (delete, destructive). Confirm sem.mod is gone and modulation always uses the accent.

5 REGENERATE Tokens + Components boards from the pass-2 theme objects: new ramp, new semantics, 32 px segments.

6 SOLO STATE
Add to the node-state row and show a soloed band on the EQ (no amber ring).

7 HIGH-CONTRAST palette (it is listed in Settings).

8 interaction.md (still missing)
Knob drag px per full range, fine factor, wheel steps per parameter type; band-panel placement and collision rules; keyboard focus order; reduce-motion behaviour; touch gestures.

9 MOCKUP A11Y
Compact delta button needs aria-label; menu items must be focusable; help-overlay text must be readable by screen readers.

compAnswers.text:
COMP BRIEF §7 — DESIGN ANSWERS (pass 4, 2026-10-22)

1 LAYOUT / HERO
The GR history is the hero: 6 s across the left 776 px. Input is grey, output white, GR hangs amber from the top (10 px/dB), and upward gain rises from the bottom. The transfer square (384 px) sits to the right with the stage strip under it, then the IN/GR/OUT meters. At 640×400 the history stays full width and the curve becomes a 132 px glass inset. The stage panel becomes a strip of THR · RATIO · ATK · REL plus More.

2 CHARACTER AND SMART
Both are footer dropdowns with glyphs, next to the mode controls, because they change how the stages move, not the curve. Custom opens a docked six-dial panel. The header holds only Comp's own 32 px buttons: sidechain, stereo/link, detector & output.

3 QUADRANTS
Pull below the line to compress or expand; pull above it to lift. You can tell them apart four ways: the side of the diagonal, the shading (amber GR vs ice-violet gainUp), the quadrant glyph on the node and its strip card, and the position of the threshold diamond.

4 RANGE
The curve bends back parallel to the diagonal once the range is used. There is no extra mark.

5 TWO-CHANNEL GR
When unlinked: a solid trace for L/M and a dashed trace for R/S on the history. The GR meter splits in two, with L·R or M·S icons under it. The stereo popover holds the L/R vs M/S choice and a LINK dial.

COLOUR
Ember accent #E44A08 is ΔE 15.1 from GR #F88A3D. Output therefore stays white, and ember is used only for what you touch. sem.gainUp #B5C0F8 is ΔE ≥ 15 from the ramp, the semantics and the curve in dark, light and hc. Colour-blind: rust #944B40 with a dotted edge.

shapeAnswers.text:
SHAPE BRIEF §7 — DESIGN ANSWERS (pass 5, 2026-10-25)

1 HERO
The history is the hero: it is the only view that shows what happened to the real hits. It has two lanes: levels on top (IN dim, OUT lit), and the signed gain under its own 0 dB line (boost up in gainUp, cut down in gr, 5 px/dB). The scope is the editing surface; the strip shows where. At 640×400 the history is still the hero, with a 40 px crossover strip and a glass band strip (mini scope, ATTACK, SUSTAIN, TIME, More).

2 SCOPES
One per band, always visible, in band cards under the strip. The selected band's card is wide (644 px) and carries the six dials. The others are compact: a scope plus ATTACK and SUSTAIN. Curved funnels tie each region of the strip to its card. With one band, the single card spans the width with a 788 px scope.

3 BAND COLOUR
Every band uses the leaf accent and carries its number. The ramp is not used here, because in the EQ it means stereo placement. Lightness steps were rejected because they crowd ok and lime. The selected band is lit (22 % tint, wide card); the others get a 10 % tint that breathes with their gain. Soloed: white ring + S. Muted: hatch + M, trace removed.

4 ATTACK VS SUSTAIN, HITS
Same sign colours, different weight. The attack part (gain × w, the detector's own weight) is a 70 % fill with glow; the sustain part is a 28 % fill with an edge. Every detected hit gets a leaf tick on the lane divider, as tall as the hit is sharp. Ticks show even at Init.

5 NO MODE SWITCH
One band = no crossovers: a 36 px rail with ghost grips at both ends. Pull one in, or double-click, and the rail grows to 80 px, the card splits, and the funnels appear. Remove the last crossover and it folds back.

ALSO
• Detector filter: hidden in multiband (the crossovers do its job). Listen, floor and lookahead stay.
• Clip (later): a footer toggle plus a draggable ceiling on the level lane; what it removes is filled in gr above the line.
• Merge: dragging, the growing band survives; double-click, the selected band, otherwise the lower one.

COLOUR
Leaf #6BA208 (light #495E21, hc #5DFF2B) is ΔE ≥ 16 from the ramp and semantics, and 53.6 / 45.7 from gainUp / gr. Blush sat between those two in hue. Light leaf is 9.1 from Gate's light accent; Gate moves when it is designed.
